themes.disagreements: Brain metastases presence (052) is a strong prognostic factor without effect modification, whereas calvarium lesions (057) and location (051) show complementary signals for effect modification.
themes.interpretation: Features describing the presence, location, and radiographic characteristics of brain metastases, showing a mix of strong prognostic signals and evidence for treatment effect modification.
themes.name: CNS Metastasis and Intracranial Involvement

themes.disagreements: Brainstem signal (054) has more robust support across multiple effect-estimation methods than brainstem size (055).
themes.interpretation: Evaluation of brainstem signal and size, where the primary evidence emerges in effect modification rather than main treatment or outcome effects.
themes.name: Brainstem Morphological Assessment

themes.disagreements: Cancer diagnosis (058) has moderate treatment-prediction support, while cancer location (059) lacks consistent signal across all roles.
themes.interpretation: Broad cancer diagnosis and primary location, which primarily serve as indicators of treatment assignment or exhibit no significant modeling signal.
themes.name: General Cancer Characteristics

themes.disagreements: Fatigue (060) is a powerful prognostic factor and candidate effect modifier, whereas calorie intake (056) is primarily associated with treatment prediction.
themes.interpretation: Nutritional status and cancer-related fatigue, showing strong prognostic value and associations with treatment prediction.
themes.name: Patient Systemic and Symptomatic State
